Projects is one row per job you are running.
Project name, address, how many jobs you have handed out on it, the total, what has been paid and what is still owed.
Flip Show Inactive and your finished jobs come back into the list.
Your live projects also sit down the left menu, so you can jump straight into one from anywhere.
Almost everything else in Kablanet hangs off a project, so this is usually where you start.
